name: beacons
title: Create Folder Beacon
description: Creates beacon.json in a project-relative folder for an updater to discover.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Beacon Name
settings.description: Name describing this folder's role; identity is allocated separately.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Human-readable title. Defaults to the beacon name when omitted.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Folder Path
settings.description: Folder to save beacon.json in. With a world selected, its root is prepended to this relative path. Without a selected world, supply an absolute folder path.

settings.name: types
settings.title: Content Types
settings.description: Enter a JSON array, for example ["ui", "functions"]. Allowed: ui, docs, tools, audits, functions. Defaults to [].

settings.name: beacon
settings.title: Beacon State
settings.description: State advertised to the updater. Creating a beacon does not start an updater.

settings.name: reach
settings.title: Reach
settings.description: JSON array containing world, project, or both. Defaults to ["world", "project"].
